why: All three checks pass and no refutation axis applies. (1) VERBATIM: curl of https://code.claude.com/docs/en/output-styles.md yields line 101 exactly as quoted - 'All output styles trigger reminders for Claude to adhere to the output style instructions during the conversation.' It is a single-sentence bullet in the '## How output styles work' list; the whole line was read and there is no second sentence reversing it. Its neighbours (:100 'adds each output style's custom instructions to the end of the system prompt', :102 keep-coding-instructions) confirm the reminder bullet is a SEPARATE, second mechanism beyond the system-prompt append, not a restatement of it. (2) CITED CODE: packages/shared/src/prompts/system.ts:438-445 is confirmed - resolveOutputStyleComposition is called at :439 inside getSystemPrompt, and 'grep -arn' (NUL-safe -a) over packages/apps/scripts finds no other production reference; the sibling formatOutputStylePrompt (output-styles.ts:591) is a thin wrapper with test-only callers. The composition returns a '## Output Style: <label>' block appended to the system prompt (output-styles.ts:564-589). (3) CONSEQUENCE, verified independently of the identifier: I read both per-turn builders in packages/shared/src/agent/core/prompt-builder.ts - buildVolatileContextParts (:219-262) emits date/time, session_state, source state, pending-plugin-auth reminder and project context files; buildStableContextParts (:279-305) emits workspace capabilities, working directory, skill listing and workflow size guidance. Neither carries a style block. There is a live per-turn user-tail injection channel and a live <system-reminder> channel in this fork (prompt-builder.ts:374-380, SessionManager.ts:15525/16206, task-notification.ts:56) - so the mechanism exists and the output style simply is not on it. Both shipped backends have the same single injection point: pi-agent.ts:6586 and claude-agent.ts:1244 (presetAppend) each call getSystemPrompt once per turn; on the Claude path the style is handed to the Agent SDK as opaque appended prose, so the SDK cannot recognise it as an output style and cannot generate the reminders either. capabilities/runtime-output-styles.ts explicitly states 'Nothing here APPLIES a style' - it only sources plugin style CONTENT. Sibling-subsystem check: the only nearby style logic is resolveChildOutputStyleId (pi-agent.ts:6601), which deliberately withholds the style from NAMED subagents per output-styles.md:104 - that is doc-conformant and is a different subsystem, not this gap. NOT an owner decision: I read all nine dated decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, listSessionSummaries/listSessions) - none touches output-style reminders. NOT a fork product difference: nothing here involves subscription flows, the corporate gateway, or NESSY_ renaming. The gap is already recorded as 'documented, not implemented' at 2026-07-29-deviation-register.md:232, generated from the category string at plans/2026-07-29-output-style-contract.md:202 - which corroborates the finding rather than refuting it (a recorded deviation is not a decision-with-reason not to implement).
correctedState: Sharpen two wordings; the substance stands. (a) 'composed exactly once' is imprecise: getSystemPrompt runs on EVERY turn (pi-agent.ts:6586, claude-agent.ts:1244), so the style block is re-composed and re-sent in the system prompt with each request. What is missing is a SECOND injection point - the style is never restated on the user-message tail or in a <system-reminder>, and this fork has both channels in active use for other content (prompt-builder.ts:374-380, SessionManager.ts:15525/16206, task-notification.ts:56). (b) 'the style decays with distance from the prefix' is an unmeasured inference, not evidence; the verifiable divergence is the absent second injection point, not a demonstrated drift. Additions: the absence is backend-wide - on the Claude path the style rides presetAppend as opaque prose, so the Agent SDK cannot emit the reminders either; and the deliberate exclusion of the style from named subagents (resolveChildOutputStyleId, per output-styles.md:104) is doc-conformant and outside this finding.
